scope: Inventory of actual numbered theorem-like environments in the release SSRN source; no completion percentage is inferred.

rows.label: lem:micro
rows.scope_note: Steady-state filtering/OGD under their distinct information and objective assumptions; not identification of learning from fitted market persistence.

rows.label: lem:cm
rows.scope_note: Positive stable response class; verify initial-state and a=0 boundary conventions before reuse.

rows.label: thm:merged
rows.scope_note: Merged measure, not ownership or multiplicity at equal rates. Pole count does not by itself certify the unformalized minimal-realization step.

rows.label: prop:endogenous_kappa
rows.scope_note: Rewritten: common selected fixed point; Lipschitz/contraction sensitivity. New scalar bound does not derive a dealer equilibrium or covariance-only information set.

rows.label: thm:quantity
rows.scope_note: Separate executed quantity, disturbance and testing resources. Exact Gaussian quantile identity and solvency converse have historically narrower formal coverage.

rows.label: thm:kcohort
rows.scope_note: Finite record and binomial pair formally supported; distinguish from a quadrature construction and constants uniform in record length.

rows.label: prop:esprit
rows.scope_note: Revised statement. Existing two-point wrapper is insufficient; inspect all-K Prony/inverse-map declarations and the exact compact rich parameter class.

rows.label: cor:unknown_primitives
rows.scope_note: Plug-in stability is conditional on bounded primitive error and nonzero impact; does not identify the fundamental proxy from prices.

rows.label: thm:minphase
rows.scope_note: Revised statement. Separate zero geometry, spectral factorization, known innovation variance and minimum-phase normalization.

rows.label: prop:passive
rows.scope_note: Finite-record sample bounds have actual Gaussian-law proofs; divergence-rate asymptotics and matching rate lower bound remain separate written obligations.

rows.label: prop:tagged
rows.scope_note: Instrument nonsingularity is supported. Stationary IV ergodic/CLT steps and independence of reporting errors from the whole price path are separate obligations.

rows.label: thm:discvalue
rows.scope_note: Reset experiment and stationary passive IV are different contracts; keep noise laws, known probe and rate accuracy metric explicit.

rows.label: prop:strategic
rows.scope_note: Rewritten conditional limits. Old wrapper assumes the cost/profit gap. No unrestricted account splitting or equilibrium evasion theorem.

rows.label: prop:target
rows.scope_note: Exact K=2 witness and finite Gaussian price-record bound checked in prior release. All-K dominant-weight gap absent; label executability and response conditions retained.

rows.label: prop:robust_gate
rows.scope_note: Actual product-Gaussian unsafe event bound checked in prior release. Scalar R readings remain hypothetical; direct flow bridge is a separate contract.

rows.label: prop:priced_decision
rows.scope_note: Fixed-menu affine optimization and acquisition algebra checked. No optimum over all interventions or acquisition schemes.

rows.label: thm:abstain
rows.scope_note: Decision/algebra support does not establish the autoregression path divergence; inspect its derivation and horizon regime.

rows.label: prop:passive0
rows.scope_note: Three-step decision reduction has support; observational variance formula and independent block assumptions require written review.

rows.label: prop:primitives
rows.scope_note: Separate observable price law from assumed known a, impact and fundamental; simultaneous primitive identification is an additional problem.

rows.label: prop:tied
rows.scope_note: Exact tied-rate equivalence must preserve positivity and total weight; does not establish a named trader class.

rows.label: prop:crb
rows.scope_note: Local unbiased/regular information benchmark is not a minimax bound over biased estimators.

rows.label: prop:tri
rows.scope_note: Region algebra is conditional on declared session, capital and observation contracts; do not infer a real trading timescale.

rows.label: thm:spectral
rows.scope_note: Mapped wrapper verifies positivity and scalar rearrangement. Parseval, information-to-execution reduction, process-noise covariance KL and numerical infimum require separate correspondence checks.

rows.label: thm:adaptive
rows.scope_note: Mapped wrapper assumes the information inequality. Added stopped likelihood/integrability conditions; ratio of lower bounds does not bound achievable savings.

rows.label: thm:rh
rows.scope_note: Mapped scalar completion-of-square result does not certify the full generalized-eigenvector decomposition or numerical optimization. Review degeneracies and all denominators.

rows.label: cor:garch
rows.scope_note: Heteroskedastic scaling alone is not a proof under arbitrary conditional volatility or endogenous observation errors.

rows.label: thm:uniformw1
rows.scope_note: Confirm target Wasserstein class, tail bound and discretization against the typed declaration; no finite-support assumption may be silently transferred.

rows.label: thm:blind
rows.scope_note: Constructive variance-matching example within its triangular model; not a general theorem that all volatility information is useless.

rows.label: lem:altpair
rows.scope_note: Explicit matched pair supplies moment/Wasserstein separation; does not automatically give a largest-class action gap.

rows.label: thm:general
rows.scope_note: Explicit binomial/cosine and constructive approximation proofs differ from the written approximation route and constants; compare the two versions, not just the order.

rows.label: lem:toeplitz
rows.scope_note: Fundamental-mark round trip and average linear-book execution. Fairness alone does not supply the claimed arbitrary camouflage cost coefficient.

rows.label: thm:cap
rows.scope_note: Positive monotone response and specified marking/margin convention; not universal protection of leveraged accounts.

rows.label: prop:disclosure
rows.scope_note: Third-mark identity at common initial receipt, inventory and fee convention; economic utility needs a holding/exit decision.

rows.label: thm:capital
rows.scope_note: Formal coercivity constant has the stated form but not necessarily the manuscript explicit modal bound; converse pulse margin remains written.

rows.label: thm:twocohort
rows.scope_note: Known pair/determinant calculation differs from unknown mixture estimation; keep amplitude and experiment horizon fixed.

rows.label: prop:choice
rows.scope_note: Stylized fixed-cost sharing and waiting harm. Algebra is conditional accounting, not calibrated regulator welfare.
